name: QVeris Finance Integration Benchmark
description: 50-task real-data finance workflow benchmark covering five finance task types; manual golden validation remains pending.
benchmark_goal: Measure whether QVeris integration improves finance workflow outcomes compared with the same agent running with public non-QVeris sources but no QVeris access.

tiers.0: Failed - answer wrong, not found, or task abandoned.
tiers.15: Partial - core data has gaps or biases but direction is correct.
tiers.30: Perfect - task fully solved, numbers and facts accurate.

tiers.0: Hallucinated or fabricated data / parameters, or pipeline errored.
tiers.10: Cited third-party web pages or news - time-sensitive and lower-confidence.
tiers.25: Cited an authoritative API or QVeris tool - source is traceable and high-confidence.

tiers.0: Returned a paragraph of prose that needs re-reading to extract data.
tiers.10: Returned messy text or a simple markdown table - partly structured.
tiers.20: Returned JSON / DataFrame / rich markdown table - directly machine-consumable.

tiers.0: Got stuck in a loop or exceeded the step budget.
tiers.8: Took 3-5 attempts / required retries / used up to 2x expected steps.
tiers.15: Hit the answer in <= expected_tool_chain length (or <= rubric.max_tool_calls / 3).

tiers.0: Contains significant ad text, raw HTML, or irrelevant noise.
tiers.10: Only task-relevant data - no ads, HTML noise, or boilerplate.
